title: Database Entity Relationships (ER Diagram)
purpose: Document all 12+ PostgreSQL tables with columns, data types, foreign keys, indexes, relationships, and enums for the PoDM platform
audience: Backend developers, database administrators, new engineers onboarding, data analysts
description: Complete entity-relationship diagram covering all PostgreSQL tables in the PoDM platform. Core entities: profiles (users with roles fan/creator/admin), content (media posts with visibility levels), subscriptions (fan-to-creator with tier support), transactions (payment ledger for tips/subscriptions/PPV/payouts), messages and conversations (direct messaging), analytics_events (engagement tracking), galleries (saved content), support_tickets (customer support with JSONB conversation), contests and contest_entries (creator competitions), referrals and referral_redemptions (referral system), enclave_applications (premium membership), and platform_settings. The profiles table is the central hub connected to 14+ other entities through foreign key relationships.

dataStores.label: profiles
dataStores.description: Core user table. uuid id PK, text username UK, text email UK, text role (fan|creator|admin), text status (active|suspended|banned|pending_verification), text display_name, text avatar_url, text banner_url, text bio, jsonb social_links, text crypto_wallet_address, text crypto_wallet_type, text crypto_wallet_payout_preference, timestamp created_at, timestamp updated_at

dataStores.label: content
dataStores.description: Media content table. uuid id PK, uuid creator_id FK→profiles, text title, text description, jsonb file_urls, text thumbnail_url, text media_type (photo|video|audio|text), text visibility (subscribers_only|pay_per_view|public), int price, int min_tier_level, boolean is_scheduled, timestamp publish_date, text status (active|deleted|flagged|removed), timestamp created_at, timestamp updated_at

dataStores.label: subscriptions
dataStores.description: Fan-to-creator subscription table. uuid id PK, uuid fan_id FK→profiles, uuid creator_id FK→profiles, text tier_id FK, text status (active|cancelled|expired|past_due), int amount_in_cents, timestamp current_period_start, timestamp current_period_end, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: transactions
dataStores.description: Payment ledger table. uuid id PK, uuid fan_id FK→profiles, uuid creator_id FK→profiles, uuid content_id FK→content, text type (Tip|Subscription|PPV|Payout|Refund), text status (Pending|Completed|Failed|Refunded|Cleared), int amount_in_cents, int platform_fee, int creator_payout, text stripe_payment_intent_id, text blockchain_tx_hash, text payment_method (stripe|crypto), text payment_currency (USD|USDC), int chain_id, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: messages
dataStores.description: Direct message table. uuid id PK, uuid conversation_id FK→conversations, uuid sender_id FK→profiles, text content, text message_type (text|voice|ppv), boolean is_read, boolean is_deleted, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: conversations
dataStores.description: Conversation grouping table. uuid id PK, jsonb participants (UUID array), timestamp last_message_at, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: analytics_events
dataStores.description: Engagement tracking table. uuid id PK, uuid fan_id FK→profiles, uuid creator_id FK→profiles, uuid content_id FK→content, text event_type, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: galleries
dataStores.description: Saved content table. uuid id PK, uuid fan_id FK→profiles, uuid content_id FK→content, timestamp saved_at

dataStores.label: support_tickets
dataStores.description: Support ticket table. uuid id PK, uuid user_id FK→profiles, text subject, text status (Open|Pending|Resolved), jsonb conversation, timestamp created_at, timestamp updated_at

dataStores.label: contests
dataStores.description: Creator contest table. uuid id PK, uuid creator_id FK→profiles, text title, text description, timestamp start_date, timestamp end_date, jsonb entry_requirements, text entry_type, int entry_multiplier, int spend_threshold, int additional_entries, text status (draft|active|completed|canceled), uuid winner_id FK→profiles, timestamp created_at, timestamp updated_at

dataStores.label: contest_entries
dataStores.description: Contest entry table. uuid id PK, uuid contest_id FK→contests, uuid fan_id FK→profiles, timestamp created_at (unique constraint on contest_id + fan_id)

dataStores.label: referral_codes
dataStores.description: Referral code table. uuid id PK, uuid user_id FK→profiles, text referral_code UK, text bonus_type (cash|percent), int bonus_value, int uses_count, int total_bonus_earned, boolean is_active, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: referral_redemptions
dataStores.description: Referral redemption tracking. uuid id PK, uuid referral_id FK→referral_codes, uuid applicant_user_id FK→profiles, int bonus_awarded, timestamp milestone_750_reached_at, int speed_bonus_amount, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: enclave_applications
dataStores.description: Enclave premium membership applications. uuid id PK, text full_name, text email, text[] current_platform, int follower_count, text[] content_type, text why_join, text how_heard, text referral_code, text status (pending|accepted|rejected), uuid reviewed_by FK→profiles, timestamp reviewed_at, timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: reports
dataStores.description: Content report table. uuid id PK, uuid content_id FK→content, uuid reporter_id FK→profiles, text reason, text status (pending|dismissed), timestamp created_at

dataStores.label: platform_settings
dataStores.description: Platform configuration table. uuid id PK, text key UK, jsonb value, timestamp updated_at

preconditions: Supabase PostgreSQL instance running with all migrations applied
RLS policies configured per table for access control
Database indexes created on foreign keys and frequently queried columns
postconditions: All entity relationships documented for developer reference
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity across all related tables
Unique constraints prevent duplicates on critical fields (email, username, tx_hash)

validationRules: Email must be unique across all profiles (unique constraint on profiles.email)
Username must be unique across all profiles (unique constraint on profiles.username)
blockchain_tx_hash must be unique across all transactions (prevents replay attacks)
contest_id + fan_id unique constraint prevents duplicate contest entries
Status fields restricted to defined enum values via application-level validation (no CHECK constraints at DB level in current schema)
Role restricted to: fan, creator, admin
Content visibility restricted to: subscribers_only, pay_per_view, public
Transaction type restricted to: Tip, Subscription, PPV, Payout, Refund
businessRules: Profiles table is the central hub — 14+ foreign key references from other tables
Transactions are append-only — no updates, no hard deletes
Messages use soft-delete (is_deleted flag) rather than hard delete
Support ticket conversation stored as JSONB array rather than relational table
No TTL or archive policy on analytics_events — unbounded growth
No cascade delete on any relationship — data integrity by preservation
subscriptions.stripe_subscription_id repurposed to store blockchain txHash
profiles.crypto_wallet_address also stores Stripe payment method tokens (column misuse)
securityConsiderations: Supabase RLS policies should restrict row-level access per user role
No CHECK constraints on status fields — application-level enforcement only
Password hashes stored in Supabase Auth, not in profiles table
Verification document paths stored in profiles.verification_data JSONB — accessed via 60-second signed URLs
No TTL on analytics_events — indefinite storage of user behavior data (GDPR consideration)
No hard delete mechanism across any table — data persists indefinitely
performanceConsiderations: Missing indexes may cause slow queries on large tables (especially transactions.created_at, analytics_events.created_at)
analytics_events has no TTL or archive — queries will slow as table grows indefinitely
JSONB conversation array in support_tickets may become slow for long conversations
profiles table is heavily referenced — ensure all FK columns are indexed
COUNT(*) queries on large tables used for dashboard analytics (no pre-aggregation)
